newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thai sees new ex-Frankfurt freighter full.
newsitem.headline: Thai sees new ex-Frankfurt freighter full.

text.p: Thai Airways International Ltd. said its new weekly Frankfurt-Asia freighter service has generated high load factors on its first two flights.
The flight has replaced one of the two weekly Frankfurt-Bangkok freighters operated by partner Lufthansa Cargo AG but remains a joint service in Thai colours.
The airline's cargo sales manager Germany, Guillermo Valencia, said the first B747-200 flight, with 115 tonnes capacity, left Frankfurt carrying 112 tonnes on Friday, October 4.
The October 11 freighter was also very full, he told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Up to November 30, the freighter will continue from Bangkok on Saturdays on to Manila, Taipei and Hong Kong, Valencia said.
No decision had yet been made on the routing from December, however, he added.
The airline had the right under its cargo alliance with Lufthansa to operate an ex-Frankfurt freighter when it had an aircraft available, he pointed out.
Thai Airways has leased the B747-200F from Atlas Air under a three-year agreement.
The deal also included options to lease a second and third Atlas aircraft in the first and third quarters of 1998 for three years each. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
